name: Clarks Fork of the Yellowstone
blurb: South-central Montana's other Clarks Fork — Bridger and Fromberg water, not the Idaho canyon.

sections.notes: Bridger has an FWP-listed gravel ramp. Edgar Bridge Fishing Access is an agency-documented public access area, but its exact boat landing and carry are not confirmed. Check both ends during your shuttle. Irrigation diversions require current local guidance; unconfirmed town and bridge exits are not alternatives.
sections.distanceReview: River distance is being checked. Confirm trip length and timing with a current local guide before launching; a float-time estimate is not available for this stretch yet.
sections.routeReview: The available river-course lines cross a wooded island near Edgar and do not reliably follow the current channel. The access map is available, but a dotted river path and GPS time remaining are not available.
